character.name: Zorvain
character.background: Wandering plague doctor who bargains with restless spirits for cures and secrets

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within 120 feet. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within 30 feet that lasts for 1 minute. The illusion has no physical effect, and creatures can use their action to investigate it, seeing through it if they succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: A creature of your choice within 60 feet regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

spells.name: Witch Bolt
spells.description: A beam of crackling blue energy lashes out toward a creature within 90 feet. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d12 lightning damage. On each of your turns for the next minute, you can use a bonus action to deal 1d12 lightning damage to the target automatically.

traits: Can see and commune with lingering spirits of plague victims, who trade secrets for small offerings
Refuses to treat those who have harmed the restless dead, no matter the payment offered
Leaves honey cakes at every crossroads to appease wayward spirits
His curative tinctures are infused with spirit-bound grave moss, making them effective but faintly haunted
character.gear: Waxed leather plague coat · Beaked linen mask · Spirit offering pouch of honey cakes and copper · Rusty autopsy scalpel · Tattered journal of spirit bargains · 50 ft hemp rope · Wax-sealed vial of grave dirt
character.story: Zorvain is the sole survivor of the Red Pox that annihilated his marsh village, saved by a spirit who bargained for his service as a wandering plague doctor. He now travels the mist-shrouded fens, trading cures for virulent fevers for promises of peace for restless spirits. His mask is stained with the blood of the dead, and his satchel holds both healing herbs and the soul-coins he uses to pay his spirit patrons. He never lingers in one place, for the dead always call him to the next outbreak.

inventory.name: Ritual Autopsy Scalpel
inventory.lore: Forged from a melted cemetery gate hinge, this scalpel has performed over a hundred autopsies on plague victims. Spirits whisper it can cut through flesh and curses alike if the wielder speaks the right prayer.
inventory.description: A small, rust-stained iron scalpel with a handle wrapped in plague-stiffened linen.

inventory.name: Spirit-Woven Plague Coat
inventory.lore: Crafted by the marsh witch who forged the beaked mask, this waxed leather coat is reinforced with thread woven from spirit hair. It repels rot and claw, and spirits refuse to touch the fabric for fear of being bound to its plague stains.
inventory.description: Heavy waxed leather coat with a high collar and deep pockets for herbs and vials.
inventory.effects: Resistance to necrotic damage from undead creatures

inventory.name: Beaked Spirit Mask
inventory.lore: Crafted by a marsh witch who bargained with a fever spirit for the power to cure the Red Pox, this mask glows faintly when spirits are near and filters out all plague miasma.
inventory.description: Wax-coated leather mask with a long curved beak stuffed with lavender, wormwood, and grave moss.
inventory.effects: Advantage on saving throws against disease

inventory.name: Spirit Offering Pouch
inventory.lore: Zorvain’s mother gave him this pouch before the Red Pox took her, telling him spirits always demand a toll for their help. He has never missed a crossroads offering in 12 years of wandering.
inventory.description: Linen pouch filled with honey cakes, dried lilac, and tarnished copper coins.
inventory.effects: Can be used to bribe a spirit for a minor favor or safe passage

inventory.name: Tattered Journal of Cursed Cures
inventory.lore: Found in the ruins of a plague doctor’s cottage in the Ashen Mire, this journal contains cures for virulent fevers and rituals to bind spirits—each requiring a steep, often deadly price.
inventory.description: Water-stained leather journal with pages filled with cramped, ink-stained notes. The ink is made from grave moss and spirit blood.
inventory.effects: Contains 3 usable cure rituals, each requiring a spirit offering to activate

inventory.name: Healing Potion
inventory.lore: Brewed from herbs grown on plague victims’ graves and infused with a minor healing spirit, these potions restore health but leave the drinker with faint whispers of the dead for an hour after consumption.
inventory.description: Frothy red liquid in a corked glass vial.

inventory.name: Grave Dirt Vial
inventory.lore: Collected from the mass grave where Zorvain’s entire village was buried during the Red Pox, this dirt is bound to the spirits of his family, who attack any undead that threaten him when the vial is broken.
inventory.description: Wax-sealed glass vial filled with dark, damp grave dirt.
inventory.effects: When broken, releases a 10-foot radius cloud that frightens all undead creatures for 1 minute

inventory.name: Hemp Rope (50ft)
inventory.lore: Stained with grave dirt and spirit ichor from dozens of pacts, this rope is used by Zorvain to bind spirits who try to renege on their bargains.
inventory.description: Frayed length of sturdy hemp rope.
inventory.effects: Can be used to bind a spirit for 1 minute, forcing it to fulfill a prior bargain
